answer: Standing grows like a reef: each identity is only as credible as the thread of attestations wound around it by established peers who share no kin tie to it. A newcomer holds a single pale pearl of reputation until unrelated others vouch, and every voucher stakes its own weight against the endorsement. Sybils can mint endless names but cannot weave independent threads, because the peers they would need to vouch are precisely the ones they do not control.
